title: Claude Code's plugin-authoring skill and its API declarations (2.1.316)
url: bundled with Claude Code 2.1.316: plugin-authoring/SKILL.md, reference.md, types/claude-code.d.ts
summary: The skill Claude Code ships for writing mods, read in this session: where a mod's three files go, how it hot-reloads, and the full typed API (about 23,000 lines). The engine interface $ has plugin, ui, model, audio, mcp, session, turn, prompt, tool, command, config, telemetry, agent, fs, store, state, clock, http, process, settings, env and the surfaces. Relevant here: $.ui.open draws a Pane; the AbovePrompt band shows on terminal and desktop; $.ui.status, $.ui.toast and $.ui.notify; $.command.register with a command.run hook; $.session.send sends plain text to another agent or session (the SendMessage tool's own delivery); $.session.messages reads a transcript; $.agent.spawn and $.agent.list; $.mcp.call calls a tool on a connected MCP server with no permission prompt; $.http.fetch goes through the host; $.process.run runs a command; $.fs reads files; $.clock.every runs timers; $.prompt.submit queues a prompt that starts a turn once the session is idle. The API is early access and moves between releases.
ideas: $.mcp.call lets a mod read thread status from any connected MCP server, for example one that lists cloud sessions.
$.prompt.submit lets a button hand Samuel's words to the session's own Claude, so the session records them as it records chat.
$.session.send reaches another session as a peer's message, never as the user's consent.
$.clock.every in session.start keeps a board fresh without a turn.
A mod's own test kit (claude plugin test) draws a pane on a named surface and presses its buttons.
